//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"reflect"
	"runtime"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf16"
	"unicode/utf8"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

// These declarations let the probe reuse the controller's Windows process owner.
type child interface {
	Input() io.WriteCloser
	Output() io.ReadCloser
	Errors() io.ReadCloser
	Done() <-chan struct{}
	Result() error
	PID() uint32
	Finish() (bool, error)
}
type platform interface {
	Preflight() (map[string]any, error)
	StartWithEnvironment(string, []string, string, []string) (child, error)
}

var newPlatform func() (platform, error)

const mappingByteLimit = 1 << 20
const mappingRowLimit = 128

type mappingOwner struct {
	SID              string `json:"sid"`
	AuthenticationID string `json:"authentication_id"`
	WindowsBuild     uint32 `json:"windows_build"`
}
type mappingRow struct {
	LocalPath  string `json:"local_path"`
	RemotePath string `json:"remote_path"`
}
type mappingConnection struct {
	Status     uint32 `json:"status"`
	RemotePath string `json:"remote_path"`
}
type mappingSnapshot struct {
	Owner         mappingOwner                 `json:"owner"`
	Rows          []mappingRow                 `json:"rows"`
	Connections   map[string]mappingConnection `json:"connections"`
	Devices       map[string][]string          `json:"dos_devices"`
	LogicalDrives uint32                       `json:"logical_drives"`
}
type mappingLedger struct {
	Version          int             `json:"version"`
	RunID            string          `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA        string          `json:"source_sha"`
	Nonce            string          `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	Volume           string          `json:"volume"`
	Sequence         uint64          `json:"sequence"`
	Owner            mappingOwner    `json:"owner"`
	LocalPath        string          `json:"local_path"`
	RemotePath       string          `json:"remote_path"`
	TCPPort          uint16          `json:"tcp_port_argument"`
	Transport        string          `json:"transport_argument"`
	RequireIntegrity bool            `json:"require_integrity_argument"`
	Persistent       bool            `json:"persistent_argument"`
	Global           bool            `json:"global_argument"`
	SaveCredentials  bool            `json:"save_credentials_argument"`
	State            string          `json:"state"`
	Baseline         mappingSnapshot `json:"baseline"`
	ObservedRow      *mappingRow     `json:"observed_row,omitempty"`
	ObservedDevice   []string        `json:"observed_dos_device,omitempty"`
	CreateOutcome    mappingMutation `json:"create_outcome"`
	RemoveOutcome    mappingMutation `json:"remove_outcome"`
}
type mappingMutation struct {
	Knowledge      string  `json:"knowledge"`
	Code           *uint32 `json:"api_status,omitempty"`
	HelperQuiesced bool    `json:"helper_quiesced"`
}
type mappingOutcomeError struct {
	Cause   error
	Outcome mappingMutation
}

func (e *mappingOutcomeError) Error() string { return e.Cause.Error() }
func (e *mappingOutcomeError) Unwrap() error { return e.Cause }

type mappingFacts struct {
	Ledger          string       `json:"ledger"`
	Owner           mappingOwner `json:"owner"`
	LocalPath       string       `json:"local_path"`
	RemotePath      string       `json:"remote_path"`
	TCPPortArgument uint16       `json:"tcp_port_argument"`
	State           string       `json:"state"`
	DOSDevice       []string     `json:"dos_device"`
}
type mappingBackend interface {
	Snapshot(context.Context) (mappingSnapshot, error)
	Create(context.Context, mappingLedger) error
	Remove(context.Context, mappingLedger, mappingRow) error
}
type mappingLedgerStore interface {
	Create(mappingLedger) error
	Save(mappingLedger) error
}
type ownedSMBMapping struct {
	options           options
	path              string
	ledger            mappingLedger
	backend           mappingBackend
	store             mappingLedgerStore
	removeAuthority   bool
	publicationFailed bool
	liveAttempt       bool
}

func (m *ownedSMBMapping) LocalPath() string { return m.ledger.LocalPath }
func (m *ownedSMBMapping) Facts() mappingFacts {
	return mappingFacts{m.path, m.ledger.Owner, m.ledger.LocalPath, m.ledger.RemotePath, m.ledger.TCPPort, m.ledger.State, append([]string(nil), m.ledger.ObservedDevice...)}
}

func mappingOptions(o options) error {
	if !identifier(o.RunID, 64) || !lowerHex(o.SourceSHA, 40) || !lowerHex(o.FixtureNonce, 64) || o.Volume != fixtureVolume || o.Sequence == 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping requires the exact fixture run, source, nonce, volume and sequence")
	}
	if o.Phase != "current-smb-cold" && o.Phase != "current-smb-cleanup" {
		return errors.New("mapping requires an explicit cold or cleanup phase")
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(o.StateFile) || filepath.Base(o.StateFile) != "probe-state.json" || filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(o.StateFile)) != "evidence" {
		return errors.New("mapping state must be the private RUN/evidence/probe-state.json")
	}
	for _, path := range []string{filepath.Dir(o.StateFile), filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(o.StateFile))} {
		if err := validatePrivateDirectory(path); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func matchingRows(snapshot mappingSnapshot, local, remote string) (*mappingRow, error) {
	var selected *mappingRow
	for _, row := range snapshot.Rows {
		if strings.EqualFold(row.LocalPath, local) || strings.EqualFold(row.RemotePath, remote) {
			if row.LocalPath != local || row.RemotePath != remote || selected != nil {
				return nil, errors.New("mapping drive or nonce share has a mismatched or duplicate row")
			}
			copy := row
			selected = &copy
		}
	}
	return selected, nil
}

func checkMappingSnapshot(snapshot mappingSnapshot) error {
	if (!strings.HasPrefix(snapshot.Owner.SID, "S-1-") || len(snapshot.Owner.SID) > 184) || !lowerHex(snapshot.Owner.AuthenticationID, 16) || snapshot.Owner.WindowsBuild < 26100 {
		return errors.New("mapping inventory lacks native owner/logon/build facts")
	}
	if snapshot.LogicalDrives&^uint32((1<<26)-1) != 0 {
		return errors.New("logical-drive inventory contains undefined bits")
	}
	if snapshot.Rows == nil || len(snapshot.Rows) > mappingRowLimit || len(snapshot.Devices) != 26 || len(snapshot.Connections) != 26 {
		return errors.New("mapping inventory exceeds bounds or lacks all DOS drives")
	}
	used := map[string]bool{}
	for _, row := range snapshot.Rows {
		if len(row.LocalPath) > 1024 || len(row.RemotePath) > 1024 || row.RemotePath == "" {
			return errors.New("mapping row is malformed")
		}
		if row.LocalPath != "" {
			connection, ok := snapshot.Connections[row.LocalPath]
			if !ok || connection.Status != 0 || connection.RemotePath != row.RemotePath {
				return errors.New("enumerated mapping differs from its local-name lookup")
			}
			key := strings.ToUpper(row.LocalPath)
			if used[key] {
				return errors.New("mapping inventory contains duplicate drive rows")
			}
			used[key] = true
		}
	}
	for letter := 'A'; letter <= 'Z'; letter++ {
		name := string(letter) + ":"
		connection, ok := snapshot.Connections[name]
		if !ok || (connection.Status != mappingNoError && connection.Status != mappingNotConnected && connection.Status != mappingConnectionUnavailable) ||
			(connection.Status == 0 && (connection.RemotePath == "" || len(connection.RemotePath) > 1024)) || (connection.Status != 0 && connection.RemotePath != "") {
			return errors.New("connection lookup inventory is incomplete or malformed")
		}
		targets, ok := snapshot.Devices[name]
		if !ok || len(targets) > 32 {
			return errors.New("DOS drive inventory is incomplete or too large")
		}
		for _, target := range targets {
			if target == "" || len(target) > 8192 {
				return errors.New("DOS drive target is malformed")
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func chooseMappingDrive(snapshot mappingSnapshot) (string, error) {
	if err := checkMappingSnapshot(snapshot); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	for letter := 'Z'; letter >= 'D'; letter-- {
		drive := string(letter) + ":"
		if snapshot.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(letter-'A')) != 0 || len(snapshot.Devices[drive]) != 0 || snapshot.Connections[drive].Status != mappingNotConnected {
			continue
		}
		free := true
		for _, row := range snapshot.Rows {
			if strings.EqualFold(row.LocalPath, drive) {
				free = false
				break
			}
		}
		if free {
			return drive, nil
		}
	}
	return "", errors.New("no drive is absent from SMB, DOS-device and logical-drive inventories")
}

func preserveMappingBaseline(ledger mappingLedger, now mappingSnapshot) error {
	if err := checkMappingSnapshot(now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if now.Owner != ledger.Owner {
		return errors.New("mapping cleanup SID or authentication logon changed")
	}
	for _, before := range ledger.Baseline.Rows {
		found := false
		for _, row := range now.Rows {
			if row.LocalPath == before.LocalPath && row.RemotePath == before.RemotePath {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return errors.New("a baseline SMB mapping disappeared or changed")
		}
	}
	for drive, targets := range ledger.Baseline.Devices {
		if drive == ledger.LocalPath {
			continue
		}
		if !reflect.DeepEqual(targets, now.Devices[drive]) {
			return errors.New("a baseline DOS device changed")
		}
		if ledger.Baseline.Connections[drive] != now.Connections[drive] {
			return errors.New("a baseline local-name connection changed")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func beginSMBMapping(ctx context.Context, o options, share string, port uint16, backend mappingBackend, store mappingLedgerStore, path string) (*ownedSMBMapping, error) {
	if share != "rfs-"+o.FixtureNonce || port == 0 || o.Phase != "current-smb-cold" {
		return nil, errors.New("mapping requires the exact nonce share and nonzero custom port")
	}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	baseline, err := backend.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	drive, err := chooseMappingDrive(baseline)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	remote := `\\127.0.0.1\` + share
	if row, err := matchingRows(baseline, drive, remote); err != nil || row != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(errors.New("mapping baseline already contains the requested identity"), err)
	}
	ledger := mappingLedger{Version: 2, RunID: o.RunID, SourceSHA: o.SourceSHA, Nonce: o.FixtureNonce, Volume: o.Volume, Sequence: o.Sequence, Owner: baseline.Owner, LocalPath: drive, RemotePath: remote, TCPPort: port, Transport: "TCP", RequireIntegrity: true, State: "intent", Baseline: baseline, CreateOutcome: mappingMutation{Knowledge: "pending"}, RemoveOutcome: mappingMutation{Knowledge: "none"}}
	if err := store.Create(ledger); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	owned := &ownedSMBMapping{options: o, path: path, ledger: ledger, backend: backend, store: store, liveAttempt: true}
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	createErr := backend.Create(ctx, ledger)
	ledger.CreateOutcome = mappingMutationOutcome(createErr)
	ledger.State = "quarantined"
	if mappingMutationSucceeded(ledger.CreateOutcome) {
		ledger.State = "create-returned"
	}
	if saveErr := owned.save(ledger); saveErr != nil {
		return owned, errors.Join(createErr, saveErr)
	}
	owned.removeAuthority = mappingMutationSucceeded(ledger.CreateOutcome)
	if createErr != nil {
		return owned, createErr
	}
	now, err := backend.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	if err := preserveMappingBaseline(ledger, now); err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	row, err := matchingRows(now, drive, remote)
	if err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	if row == nil || now.Connections[drive].Status != 0 || now.Connections[drive].RemotePath != remote || len(now.Devices[drive]) == 0 {
		return owned, errors.New("mapping creation did not produce an exact connected row and DOS device")
	}
	ledger.State = "observed"
	ledger.ObservedRow = row
	ledger.ObservedDevice = append([]string(nil), now.Devices[drive]...)
	if err := owned.save(ledger); err != nil {
		return owned, err
	}
	return owned, nil
}

func mappingMutationOutcome(err error) mappingMutation {
	if err == nil {
		code := uint32(0)
		return mappingMutation{Knowledge: "returned", Code: &code, HelperQuiesced: true}
	}
	var outcome *mappingOutcomeError
	if errors.As(err, &outcome) {
		return outcome.Outcome
	}
	return mappingMutation{Knowledge: "unknown"}
}

func mappingMutationSucceeded(value mappingMutation) bool {
	return value.Knowledge == "returned" && value.Code != nil && *value.Code == 0 && value.HelperQuiesced
}

func (m *ownedSMBMapping) save(ledger mappingLedger) error {
	if err := m.store.Save(ledger); err != nil {
		m.removeAuthority = false
		m.publicationFailed = true
		return err
	}
	m.ledger = ledger
	return nil
}

func (m *ownedSMBMapping) cleanup(ctx context.Context) error {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	now, err := m.backend.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := preserveMappingBaseline(m.ledger, now); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	row, err := matchingRows(now, m.ledger.LocalPath, m.ledger.RemotePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	targets := now.Devices[m.ledger.LocalPath]
	absent := row == nil && len(targets) == 0 && now.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(m.ledger.LocalPath[0]-'A')) == 0 && now.Connections[m.ledger.LocalPath].Status == mappingNotConnected
	if m.publicationFailed {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger publication failed; live removal authority is revoked")
	}
	if !m.liveAttempt {
		return errors.New("mapping cleanup reentry is readonly and cannot settle a prior failed attempt")
	}
	if !mappingMutationSucceeded(m.ledger.CreateOutcome) {
		return errors.New("mapping creation is unresolved; provider effects remain quarantined")
	}
	if mappingMutationSucceeded(m.ledger.RemoveOutcome) {
		if !absent {
			return errors.New("mapping reappeared or remained after successful removal")
		}
		return nil
	}
	if !m.removeAuthority || m.ledger.RemoveOutcome.Knowledge != "none" {
		return errors.New("mapping cleanup is readonly without live acknowledged removal authority")
	}
	if row == nil || len(targets) == 0 || now.Connections[m.ledger.LocalPath].Status != 0 || now.Connections[m.ledger.LocalPath].RemotePath != m.ledger.RemotePath {
		return errors.New("normal removal lacks its fresh exact row, lookup and DOS binding")
	}
	if m.ledger.ObservedRow != nil && !reflect.DeepEqual(m.ledger.ObservedDevice, targets) {
		return errors.New("mapping DOS binding changed before removal")
	}
	m.removeAuthority = false
	ledger := m.ledger
	ledger.ObservedRow = row
	ledger.ObservedDevice = append([]string(nil), targets...)
	ledger.RemoveOutcome = mappingMutation{Knowledge: "pending"}
	ledger.State = "remove-pending"
	if err := m.save(ledger); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	removeErr := m.backend.Remove(ctx, ledger, *row)
	ledger.RemoveOutcome = mappingMutationOutcome(removeErr)
	ledger.State = "quarantined"
	if mappingMutationSucceeded(ledger.RemoveOutcome) {
		ledger.State = "remove-returned"
	}
	if saveErr := m.save(ledger); saveErr != nil {
		return errors.Join(removeErr, saveErr)
	}
	if removeErr != nil {
		return removeErr
	}
	after, err := m.backend.Snapshot(ctx)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := preserveMappingBaseline(ledger, after); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	remaining, err := matchingRows(after, ledger.LocalPath, ledger.RemotePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if remaining != nil || len(after.Devices[ledger.LocalPath]) != 0 || after.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(ledger.LocalPath[0]-'A')) != 0 || after.Connections[ledger.LocalPath].Status != mappingNotConnected {
		return errors.New("mapping removal did not clear all connection and drive observations")
	}
	ledger.State = "removed"
	return m.save(ledger)
}

type diskMappingStore struct {
	path     string
	o        options
	expected mappingLedger
	publish  func(string, string) error
}

func mappingLedgerPath(o options) string {
	return filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(o.StateFile), "smb-mapping.json")
}

func validateMappingLedger(ledger mappingLedger, o options) error {
	if ledger.Version != 2 || ledger.RunID != o.RunID || ledger.SourceSHA != o.SourceSHA || ledger.Nonce != o.FixtureNonce || ledger.Volume != o.Volume || ledger.Sequence == 0 || ledger.Sequence != o.Sequence {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger belongs to another run, source, nonce, volume or sequence")
	}
	if len(ledger.LocalPath) != 2 || ledger.LocalPath[0] < 'D' || ledger.LocalPath[0] > 'Z' || ledger.LocalPath[1] != ':' || ledger.RemotePath != `\\127.0.0.1\rfs-`+o.FixtureNonce || ledger.TCPPort == 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger drive, nonce share or custom port is invalid")
	}
	if ledger.Transport != "TCP" || !ledger.RequireIntegrity || ledger.Persistent || ledger.Global || ledger.SaveCredentials {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger arguments differ from private signed nonpersistent mapping")
	}
	if ledger.State != "intent" && ledger.State != "create-returned" && ledger.State != "observed" && ledger.State != "removed" && ledger.State != "remove-pending" && ledger.State != "remove-returned" && ledger.State != "quarantined" {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger state is invalid")
	}
	for index, value := range []mappingMutation{ledger.CreateOutcome, ledger.RemoveOutcome} {
		if value.Knowledge == "none" && index == 1 && value.Code == nil && !value.HelperQuiesced {
			continue
		}
		if value.Knowledge != "pending" && value.Knowledge != "unknown" && value.Knowledge != "not-invoked" && value.Knowledge != "returned" {
			return errors.New("mapping mutation knowledge is invalid")
		}
		if (value.Knowledge == "returned") != (value.Code != nil) || (value.Knowledge == "pending" && value.HelperQuiesced) {
			return errors.New("mapping mutation knowledge has contradictory fields")
		}
	}
	if (ledger.State == "create-returned" || ledger.State == "observed" || ledger.State == "remove-pending" || ledger.State == "remove-returned" || ledger.State == "removed") && !mappingMutationSucceeded(ledger.CreateOutcome) {
		return errors.New("mapping resource state lacks successful creation")
	}
	if (ledger.State == "remove-returned" || ledger.State == "removed") && !mappingMutationSucceeded(ledger.RemoveOutcome) {
		return errors.New("mapping resource state lacks successful removal")
	}
	if ledger.State == "intent" && (ledger.CreateOutcome.Knowledge != "pending" || ledger.RemoveOutcome.Knowledge != "none") {
		return errors.New("mapping create intent has contradictory outcomes")
	}
	if (ledger.State == "create-returned" || ledger.State == "observed") && ledger.RemoveOutcome.Knowledge != "none" {
		return errors.New("mapping pre-removal state contains a removal outcome")
	}
	if ledger.State == "remove-pending" && ledger.RemoveOutcome.Knowledge != "pending" {
		return errors.New("mapping removal intent lacks a pending outcome")
	}
	if (ledger.State == "remove-pending" || ledger.State == "remove-returned" || ledger.State == "removed") && (ledger.ObservedRow == nil || len(ledger.ObservedDevice) == 0) {
		return errors.New("mapping removal lacks its recorded row and DOS binding")
	}
	if err := checkMappingSnapshot(ledger.Baseline); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ledger.Owner != ledger.Baseline.Owner {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger owner differs from its baseline")
	}
	letter := ledger.LocalPath[0]
	if len(ledger.Baseline.Devices[ledger.LocalPath]) != 0 || ledger.Baseline.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(letter-'A')) != 0 || ledger.Baseline.Connections[ledger.LocalPath].Status != mappingNotConnected {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger attempts to own a baseline DOS drive")
	}
	row, err := matchingRows(ledger.Baseline, ledger.LocalPath, ledger.RemotePath)
	if err != nil || row != nil {
		return errors.Join(errors.New("mapping ledger attempts to adopt a baseline mapping"), err)
	}
	if ledger.ObservedRow != nil && (ledger.ObservedRow.LocalPath != ledger.LocalPath || ledger.ObservedRow.RemotePath != ledger.RemotePath) {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger observation differs from its intent")
	}
	if ledger.State == "observed" && (ledger.ObservedRow == nil || len(ledger.ObservedDevice) == 0) {
		return errors.New("observed mapping lacks its exact row and DOS binding")
	}
	return nil
}

func uniqueMappingJSON(data []byte) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	var value func(int) error
	value = func(depth int) error {
		if depth > 16 {
			return errors.New("mapping JSON nesting exceeds limit")
		}
		token, err := decoder.Token()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		delimiter, nested := token.(json.Delim)
		if !nested {
			return nil
		}
		if delimiter != '{' && delimiter != '[' {
			return errors.New("mapping JSON has an unexpected delimiter")
		}
		keys := map[string]bool{}
		for decoder.More() {
			if delimiter == '{' {
				keyToken, err := decoder.Token()
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				key, ok := keyToken.(string)
				if !ok || keys[key] {
					return errors.New("mapping JSON has duplicate or invalid fields")
				}
				keys[key] = true
			}
			if err := value(depth + 1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		_, err = decoder.Token()
		return err
	}
	return value(0)
}

func decodeMappingJSON(data []byte, target any) error {
	if len(data) > mappingByteLimit {
		return errors.New("mapping JSON exceeds size limit")
	}
	if !utf8.Valid(data) {
		return errors.New("mapping JSON is not valid UTF-8")
	}
	if err := uniqueMappingJSON(data); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {
		return errors.New("mapping JSON must contain exactly one value")
	}
	return nil
}

func mappingRequiredFields(data []byte, names ...string) (map[string]json.RawMessage, error) {
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &fields); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, name := range names {
		value, ok := fields[name]
		if !ok || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(value), []byte("null")) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("mapping JSON omitted %s", name)
		}
	}
	return fields, nil
}

func readMappingLedger(path string, o options) (mappingLedger, error) {
	var ledger mappingLedger
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, mappingByteLimit+1))
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if err := errors.Join(readErr, closeErr); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(data, &ledger); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &fields); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	for _, name := range []string{"version", "run_id", "source_sha", "fixture_nonce", "volume", "sequence", "owner", "local_path", "remote_path", "tcp_port_argument", "transport_argument", "require_integrity_argument", "persistent_argument", "global_argument", "save_credentials_argument", "state", "baseline", "create_outcome", "remove_outcome"} {
		value, ok := fields[name]
		if !ok || bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(value), []byte("null")) {
			return ledger, fmt.Errorf("mapping ledger lacks %s", name)
		}
	}
	return ledger, validateMappingLedger(ledger, o)
}

func writeMappingFile(file *os.File, ledger mappingLedger) error {
	return writeMappingJSONFile(file, ledger)
}

func (s *diskMappingStore) Create(ledger mappingLedger) error {
	if err := validateMappingLedger(ledger, s.o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(s.path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result := errors.Join(writeMappingFile(file, ledger), file.Close())
	if result == nil {
		s.expected = ledger
	}
	return result
}

func (s *diskMappingStore) Save(ledger mappingLedger) error {
	if err := validateMappingLedger(ledger, s.o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	current, err := readMappingLedger(s.path, s.o)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(current, s.expected) {
		return errors.New("mapping ledger changed while owned")
	}
	file, err := os.CreateTemp(filepath.Dir(s.path), ".smb-mapping-")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	temporary := file.Name()
	if err := errors.Join(writeMappingFile(file, ledger), file.Close()); err != nil {
		return errors.Join(err, os.Remove(temporary))
	}
	publish := s.publish
	if publish == nil {
		publish = replaceMappingFile
	}
	if err := publish(temporary, s.path); err != nil {
		removeErr := os.Remove(temporary)
		if errors.Is(removeErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
			removeErr = nil
		}
		return errors.Join(err, removeErr)
	}
	s.expected = ledger
	return nil
}

func replaceMappingFile(temporary, path string) error {
	from, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(temporary)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	to, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return windows.MoveFileEx(from, to, windows.MOVEFILE_REPLACE_EXISTING|windows.MOVEFILE_WRITE_THROUGH)
}

func lockMappingOwner(directory string) (func() error, error) {
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	path := filepath.Join(directory, "owner.lock")
	file, err := os.OpenFile(path, os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_RDWR, 0600)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrExist) {
		if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		file, err = os.OpenFile(path, os.O_RDWR, 0)
	} else if err == nil {
		if sealErr := makePrivateFile(path); sealErr != nil {
			return nil, errors.Join(sealErr, file.Close())
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var position windows.Overlapped
	if err := windows.LockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), windows.LOCKFILE_EXCLUSIVE_LOCK|windows.LOCKFILE_FAIL_IMMEDIATELY, 0, 1, 0, &position); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.Join(err, file.Close())
	}
	return func() error {
		return errors.Join(windows.UnlockFileEx(windows.Handle(file.Fd()), 0, 1, 0, &position), file.Close())
	}, nil
}

func newSMBMapping(ctx context.Context, o options, share string, port uint16) (owned *ownedSMBMapping, resultErr error) {
	if err := mappingOptions(o); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	backend, err := newNativeMappingBackend(o)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	native := backend.(*nativeMappingBackend)
	directory := mappingOwnerDirectory(native.root, native.owner)
	if err := createMappingClaim(directory, mappingExpectedClaim(o, native.owner, native.runner)); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	unlock, err := lockMappingOwner(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer func() { resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, unlock()) }()
	path := mappingLedgerPath(o)
	return beginSMBMapping(ctx, o, share, port, backend, &diskMappingStore{path: path, o: o}, path)
}

func (m *ownedSMBMapping) Cleanup(ctx context.Context) (resultErr error) {
	if err := mappingOptions(m.options); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	native, ok := m.backend.(*nativeMappingBackend)
	if !ok {
		return errors.New("mapping cleanup lacks its native owner context")
	}
	directory := mappingOwnerDirectory(native.root, native.owner)
	if err := validateMappingClaim(directory, mappingExpectedClaim(m.options, native.owner, native.runner)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	unlock, err := lockMappingOwner(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, unlock()) }()
	current, err := readMappingLedger(m.path, m.options)
	if err != nil {
		m.removeAuthority = false
		return err
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(current, m.ledger) {
		m.removeAuthority = false
		return errors.New("mapping durable ledger changed outside its acknowledged live state")
	}
	m.store = &diskMappingStore{path: m.path, o: m.options, expected: current}
	return m.cleanup(ctx)
}

func cleanupSMBMapping(ctx context.Context, o options) (resultErr error) {
	if err := mappingOptions(o); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	backend, err := newNativeMappingBackend(o)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	native := backend.(*nativeMappingBackend)
	directory := mappingOwnerDirectory(native.root, native.owner)
	if err := validateMappingClaim(directory, mappingExpectedClaim(o, native.owner, native.runner)); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	unlock, err := lockMappingOwner(directory)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer func() { resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, unlock()) }()
	path := mappingLedgerPath(o)
	ledger, err := readMappingLedger(path, o)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	owned := &ownedSMBMapping{options: o, path: path, ledger: ledger, backend: backend, store: &diskMappingStore{path: path, o: o, expected: ledger}}
	return owned.cleanup(ctx)
}

type mappingTokenStatistics struct {
	TokenID            windows.LUID
	AuthenticationID   windows.LUID
	Expiration         int64
	TokenType          uint32
	ImpersonationLevel uint32
	DynamicCharged     uint32
	DynamicAvailable   uint32
	GroupCount         uint32
	PrivilegeCount     uint32
	ModifiedID         windows.LUID
}

func currentMappingOwner() (mappingOwner, error) {
	var layout mappingTokenStatistics
	if unsafe.Sizeof(layout) != 56 || unsafe.Alignof(layout) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(layout.AuthenticationID) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(layout.ModifiedID) != 48 {
		return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("TOKEN_STATISTICS differs from the Windows 64-bit ABI")
	}
	token := windows.GetCurrentProcessToken()
	user, err := token.GetTokenUser()
	if err != nil {
		return mappingOwner{}, err
	}
	var elevation uint32
	var returned uint32
	if err := windows.GetTokenInformation(token, windows.TokenElevation, (*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&elevation)), 4, &returned); err != nil {
		return mappingOwner{}, err
	}
	if returned != 4 || elevation != 1 {
		return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("alternate-port SMB mapping requires an elevated administrator token")
	}
	groups, err := token.GetTokenGroups()
	if err != nil {
		return mappingOwner{}, err
	}
	administrator := false
	for _, group := range groups.AllGroups() {
		if group.Sid.IsWellKnown(windows.WinBuiltinAdministratorsSid) && group.Attributes&windows.SE_GROUP_ENABLED != 0 && group.Attributes&windows.SE_GROUP_USE_FOR_DENY_ONLY == 0 {
			administrator = true
		}
	}
	if !administrator {
		return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("alternate-port SMB mapping requires enabled Administrators membership")
	}
	var statistics mappingTokenStatistics
	if err := windows.GetTokenInformation(token, windows.TokenStatistics, (*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&statistics)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(statistics)), &returned); err != nil {
		return mappingOwner{}, err
	}
	if returned != uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(statistics)) {
		return mappingOwner{}, errors.New("token statistics returned an unexpected size")
	}
	logon := fmt.Sprintf("%08x%08x", uint32(statistics.AuthenticationID.HighPart), statistics.AuthenticationID.LowPart)
	return mappingOwner{user.User.Sid.String(), logon, windows.RtlGetVersion().BuildNumber}, nil
}

func requireMappingJob() error {
	var limits windows.JOBOBJECT_EXTENDED_LIMIT_INFORMATION
	var returned uint32
	if err := windows.QueryInformationJobObject(0, windows.JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&limits)), uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(limits)), &returned); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mapping requires the inherited F child job: %w", err)
	}
	if returned != uint32(unsafe.Sizeof(limits)) {
		return errors.New("immediate job limits returned an unexpected size")
	}
	flags := limits.BasicLimitInformation.LimitFlags
	if flags&windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE == 0 || flags&(windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_BREAKAWAY_OK|windows.JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_SILENT_BREAKAWAY_OK) != 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping requires an immediate kill-on-close job without breakaway")
	}
	return nil
}

const (
	mappingNoError               uint32 = 0
	mappingMoreData              uint32 = 234
	mappingNoMoreItems           uint32 = 259
	mappingConnectionUnavailable uint32 = 1201
	mappingNotConnected          uint32 = 2250
	mappingRequireIntegrity      uint32 = 0x4000
)

type mappingNetResource struct {
	Scope, Type, DisplayType, Usage          uint32
	LocalName, RemoteName, Comment, Provider *uint16
}

func checkMappingNativeABI() error {
	var value mappingNetResource
	if unsafe.Sizeof(value) != 48 || unsafe.Alignof(value) != 8 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.Type) != 4 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.LocalName) != 16 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.RemoteName) != 24 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.Comment) != 32 || unsafe.Offsetof(value.Provider) != 40 {
		return errors.New("NETRESOURCEW differs from the Windows 64-bit ABI")
	}
	return nil
}

func mappingTransportOptions(port uint16) ([24]byte, error) {
	var data [24]byte
	if port == 0 {
		return data, errors.New("mapping TCP port is zero")
	}
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[0:4], 0x50617254)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(data[4:6], 24)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[8:12], 1)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint16(data[14:16], port)
	binary.LittleEndian.PutUint32(data[20:24], 1)
	return data, nil
}

type mappingNativeOps struct {
	OpenEnum      func() (uintptr, uint32)
	Enum          func(uintptr, []byte, *uint32, *uint32) uint32
	CloseEnum     func(uintptr) uint32
	Connection    func(string, []uint16, *uint32) uint32
	DOS           func(string) ([]string, error)
	LogicalDrives func() (uint32, error)
	FindAdd       func() error
	Add           func(uintptr, *mappingNetResource, uintptr, uint32, uint32, []byte, uint32) uint32
	Cancel        func(string, uint32, bool) uint32
}

func mappingNativeCreate(local, remote string, port uint16, ops mappingNativeOps) (invoked bool, code uint32, resultErr error) {
	if err := checkMappingNativeABI(); err != nil {
		return false, 0, err
	}
	option, err := mappingTransportOptions(port)
	if err != nil {
		return false, 0, err
	}
	localName, err := windows.UTF16FromString(local)
	if err != nil {
		return false, 0, err
	}
	remoteName, err := windows.UTF16FromString(remote)
	if err != nil {
		return false, 0, err
	}
	if err := ops.FindAdd(); err != nil {
		return false, 0, err
	}
	resource := mappingNetResource{Type: 1, LocalName: &localName[0], RemoteName: &remoteName[0]}
	code = ops.Add(0, &resource, 0, 0, mappingRequireIntegrity, option[:], uint32(len(option)))
	runtime.KeepAlive(localName)
	runtime.KeepAlive(remoteName)
	runtime.KeepAlive(resource)
	runtime.KeepAlive(option)
	return true, code, nil
}

func mappingUTF16(words []uint16, byteLimit int) (string, error) {
	for index := 0; index < len(words); index++ {
		word := words[index]
		if word >= 0xd800 && word <= 0xdbff {
			if index+1 >= len(words) || words[index+1] < 0xdc00 || words[index+1] > 0xdfff {
				return "", errors.New("mapping string has invalid UTF-16")
			}
			index++
		} else if word >= 0xdc00 && word <= 0xdfff {
			return "", errors.New("mapping string has invalid UTF-16")
		}
	}
	value := string(utf16.Decode(words))
	if len(value) > byteLimit {
		return "", errors.New("mapping string exceeds byte bound")
	}
	return value, nil
}

func mappingBufferString(buffer []byte, pointer uintptr, required bool) (string, error) {
	if pointer == 0 {
		if required {
			return "", errors.New("mapping resource omitted its remote name")
		}
		return "", nil
	}
	if len(buffer) == 0 {
		return "", errors.New("mapping resource string has no buffer")
	}
	base := uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0]))
	if pointer < base || pointer-base >= uintptr(len(buffer)) || pointer%2 != 0 {
		return "", errors.New("mapping resource string pointer is outside its buffer")
	}
	offset := int(pointer - base)
	words := make([]uint16, 0, 1024)
	for offset+1 < len(buffer) {
		word := binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(buffer[offset : offset+2])
		if word == 0 {
			return mappingUTF16(words, 1024)
		}
		words = append(words, word)
		if len(words) > 1024 {
			return "", errors.New("mapping resource string is unterminated or too large")
		}
		offset += 2
	}
	return "", errors.New("mapping resource string is unterminated")
}

func parseMappingResources(buffer []byte, count uint32) ([]mappingRow, error) {
	if err := checkMappingNativeABI(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if count == 0 || count > mappingRowLimit || uint64(count)*48 > uint64(len(buffer)) {
		return nil, errors.New("mapping enumeration returned invalid count or array size")
	}
	if uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0]))%8 != 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("mapping enumeration buffer is unaligned")
	}
	rows := make([]mappingRow, 0, count)
	for index := uint32(0); index < count; index++ {
		header := buffer[int(index)*48 : int(index+1)*48]
		if binary.LittleEndian.Uint32(header[4:8]) != 1 {
			return nil, errors.New("mapping enumeration returned a non-disk resource")
		}
		local, err := mappingBufferString(buffer, uintptr(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(header[16:24])), false)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		remote, err := mappingBufferString(buffer, uintptr(binary.LittleEndian.Uint64(header[24:32])), true)
		if err != nil || remote == "" {
			return nil, errors.Join(err, errors.New("mapping enumeration has an empty remote name"))
		}
		rows = append(rows, mappingRow{local, remote})
	}
	return rows, nil
}

func enumerateMappings(ops mappingNativeOps) (rows []mappingRow, resultErr error) {
	handle, status := ops.OpenEnum()
	if status != mappingNoError {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("WNetOpenEnumW status %d", status)
	}
	defer func() {
		if code := ops.CloseEnum(handle); code != 0 {
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, fmt.Errorf("WNetCloseEnum status %d", code))
		}
	}()
	storage := make([]uint64, mappingByteLimit/8)
	buffer := unsafe.Slice((*byte)(unsafe.Pointer(&storage[0])), mappingByteLimit)
	rows = []mappingRow{}
	for call := 0; call < mappingRowLimit+1; call++ {
		count := uint32(max(1, mappingRowLimit-len(rows)))
		size := uint32(len(buffer))
		status := ops.Enum(handle, buffer, &count, &size)
		if status == mappingNoMoreItems {
			return rows, nil
		}
		if status != mappingNoError {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("WNetEnumResourceW incomplete status %d", status)
		}
		if count == 0 || int(count) > mappingRowLimit-len(rows) || size > uint32(len(buffer)) {
			return nil, errors.New("mapping enumeration exceeded its count/buffer or made no progress")
		}
		page, err := parseMappingResources(buffer[:size], count)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		rows = append(rows, page...)
	}
	return nil, errors.New("mapping enumeration did not terminate within call bound")
}

func mappingLookup(drive string, ops mappingNativeOps) (mappingConnection, error) {
	buffer := make([]uint16, 1025)
	size := uint32(len(buffer))
	code := ops.Connection(drive, buffer, &size)
	if code == mappingNotConnected || code == mappingConnectionUnavailable {
		return mappingConnection{Status: code}, nil
	}
	if code != 0 {
		return mappingConnection{}, fmt.Errorf("WNetGetConnectionW status %d", code)
	}
	end := 0
	for end < len(buffer) && buffer[end] != 0 {
		end++
	}
	if end == 0 || end == len(buffer) || size == 0 || size > uint32(len(buffer)) {
		return mappingConnection{}, errors.New("connection lookup returned malformed bounded text")
	}
	value, err := mappingUTF16(buffer[:end], 1024)
	return mappingConnection{Status: code, RemotePath: value}, err
}

func systemMappingOps() mappingNativeOps {
	dll := windows.NewLazySystemDLL("mpr.dll")
	open := dll.NewProc("WNetOpenEnumW")
	enumerate := dll.NewProc("WNetEnumResourceW")
	closeEnum := dll.NewProc("WNetCloseEnum")
	connection := dll.NewProc("WNetGetConnectionW")
	add := dll.NewProc("WNetAddConnection4W")
	cancel := dll.NewProc("WNetCancelConnection2W")
	return mappingNativeOps{
		OpenEnum: func() (uintptr, uint32) {
			var handle uintptr
			code, _, _ := open.Call(1, 1, 0, 0, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&handle)))
			return handle, uint32(code)
		},
		Enum: func(handle uintptr, buffer []byte, count, size *uint32) uint32 {
			code, _, _ := enumerate.Call(handle, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(count)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(size)))
			runtime.KeepAlive(buffer)
			return uint32(code)
		},
		CloseEnum: func(handle uintptr) uint32 { code, _, _ := closeEnum.Call(handle); return uint32(code) },
		Connection: func(drive string, buffer []uint16, size *uint32) uint32 {
			name, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(drive)
			if err != nil {
				return uint32(windows.ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER)
			}
			code, _, _ := connection.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(name)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&buffer[0])), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(size)))
			runtime.KeepAlive(name)
			runtime.KeepAlive(buffer)
			return uint32(code)
		},
		DOS: mappingDOSTarget, LogicalDrives: windows.GetLogicalDrives,
		FindAdd: add.Find,
		Add: func(hwnd uintptr, resource *mappingNetResource, auth uintptr, authBytes, flags uint32, option []byte, optionBytes uint32) uint32 {
			code, _, _ := add.Call(hwnd, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(resource)), auth, uintptr(authBytes), uintptr(flags), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&option[0])), uintptr(optionBytes))
			runtime.KeepAlive(resource)
			runtime.KeepAlive(option)
			return uint32(code)
		},
		Cancel: func(drive string, flags uint32, force bool) uint32 {
			name, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(drive)
			if err != nil {
				return uint32(windows.ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER)
			}
			var forced uintptr
			if force {
				forced = 1
			}
			code, _, _ := cancel.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(name)), uintptr(flags), forced)
			runtime.KeepAlive(name)
			return uint32(code)
		},
	}
}

func nativeMappingSnapshot(owner mappingOwner, ops mappingNativeOps) (mappingSnapshot, error) {
	rows, err := enumerateMappings(ops)
	if err != nil {
		return mappingSnapshot{}, err
	}
	snapshot := mappingSnapshot{Owner: owner, Rows: rows, Connections: make(map[string]mappingConnection, 26), Devices: make(map[string][]string, 26)}
	for letter := 'A'; letter <= 'Z'; letter++ {
		drive := string(letter) + ":"
		value, err := mappingLookup(drive, ops)
		if err != nil {
			return mappingSnapshot{}, err
		}
		snapshot.Connections[drive] = value
		targets, err := ops.DOS(drive)
		if err != nil {
			return mappingSnapshot{}, err
		}
		snapshot.Devices[drive] = targets
	}
	snapshot.LogicalDrives, err = ops.LogicalDrives()
	if err != nil {
		return mappingSnapshot{}, err
	}
	sort.Slice(snapshot.Rows, func(i, j int) bool {
		if snapshot.Rows[i].LocalPath != snapshot.Rows[j].LocalPath {
			return snapshot.Rows[i].LocalPath < snapshot.Rows[j].LocalPath
		}
		return snapshot.Rows[i].RemotePath < snapshot.Rows[j].RemotePath
	})
	return snapshot, checkMappingSnapshot(snapshot)
}

func mappingDOSTarget(drive string) ([]string, error) {
	name, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(drive)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	buffer := make([]uint16, 8192)
	count, err := windows.QueryDosDevice(name, &buffer[0], uint32(len(buffer)))
	if errors.Is(err, windows.ERROR_FILE_NOT_FOUND) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if count < 2 || count > uint32(len(buffer)) || buffer[count-1] != 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("DOS device returned malformed MULTI_SZ")
	}
	var targets []string
	start := 0
	for i := 0; i < int(count); i++ {
		if buffer[i] != 0 {
			continue
		}
		if i == start {
			if i != int(count)-1 {
				return nil, errors.New("DOS device returned trailing target data")
			}
			break
		}
		raw := buffer[start:i]
		for j := 0; j < len(raw); j++ {
			if raw[j] >= 0xd800 && raw[j] <= 0xdbff {
				if j+1 >= len(raw) || raw[j+1] < 0xdc00 || raw[j+1] > 0xdfff {
					return nil, errors.New("DOS target has an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate")
				}
				j++
			} else if raw[j] >= 0xdc00 && raw[j] <= 0xdfff {
				return nil, errors.New("DOS target has an unpaired UTF-16 surrogate")
			}
		}
		targets = append(targets, string(utf16.Decode(raw)))
		start = i + 1
		if len(targets) > 32 {
			return nil, errors.New("DOS target count exceeds limit")
		}
	}
	if len(targets) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("DOS device exists without a target")
	}
	return targets, nil
}

type mappingRunner struct {
	Environment string `json:"environment"`
	RunID       string `json:"run_id"`
	Attempt     string `json:"attempt"`
}
type mappingClaim struct {
	Version   int           `json:"version"`
	Owner     mappingOwner  `json:"owner"`
	RunID     string        `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA string        `json:"source_sha"`
	Nonce     string        `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	Volume    string        `json:"volume"`
	Sequence  uint64        `json:"sequence"`
	StateFile string        `json:"state_file"`
	Runner    mappingRunner `json:"runner"`
}

func mappingRootFromExecutable(executable string, o options) (string, error) {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(executable) || strings.HasPrefix(executable, `\\`) || filepath.Clean(executable) != executable {
		return "", errors.New("mapping helper executable must have a canonical local absolute path")
	}
	name := filepath.Base(executable)
	if name != "probe-windows-arm64.exe" && name != "probe-windows-amd64.exe" {
		return "", errors.New("mapping helper executable name is not fixed")
	}
	host := filepath.Dir(executable)
	artifact := filepath.Dir(host)
	root := filepath.Dir(artifact)
	if filepath.Base(host) != "host" || filepath.Base(artifact) != "artifact" || filepath.Base(root) != "native-current-authority-fixture" || filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(root)) != ".tmp" {
		return "", errors.New("mapping helper is outside the fixed artifact root")
	}
	want := filepath.Join(root, "windows-runs", o.RunID, "evidence", "probe-state.json")
	if o.StateFile != want {
		return "", errors.New("mapping state is outside the executable's fixed fixture root")
	}
	return root, nil
}

func mappingRunnerFacts(lookup func(string) string, runID string) (mappingRunner, error) {
	runner := mappingRunner{lookup("RFS_FIXTURE_RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT"), lookup("GITHUB_RUN_ID"), lookup("GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT")}
	for _, value := range []string{runner.RunID, runner.Attempt} {
		number, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 10, 64)
		if err != nil || number == 0 || strconv.FormatUint(number, 10) != value {
			return runner, errors.New("mapping requires canonical hosted run and attempt identifiers")
		}
	}
	if lookup("GITHUB_ACTIONS") != "true" || runner.Environment != "github-hosted" || runID != runner.RunID+"-"+runner.Attempt {
		return runner, errors.New("mapping requires this fresh isolated GitHub-hosted attempt")
	}
	return runner, nil
}

func mappingOwnerDirectory(root string, owner mappingOwner) string {
	key := sha256.Sum256([]byte(owner.SID + "\x00" + owner.AuthenticationID))
	return filepath.Join(root, fmt.Sprintf("mapping-owner-%x", key))
}

func mappingExpectedClaim(o options, owner mappingOwner, runner mappingRunner) mappingClaim {
	return mappingClaim{1, owner, o.RunID, o.SourceSHA, o.FixtureNonce, o.Volume, o.Sequence, o.StateFile, runner}
}

func writeMappingJSONFile(file *os.File, value any) error {
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(data)+1 > mappingByteLimit {
		return errors.New("private mapping record exceeds size limit")
	}
	if err := makePrivateFile(file.Name()); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	data = append(data, '\n')
	n, err := file.Write(data)
	if err == nil && n != len(data) {
		err = io.ErrShortWrite
	}
	return errors.Join(err, file.Sync())
}

func readMappingClaim(path string) (mappingClaim, error) {
	var claim mappingClaim
	if err := validatePrivateFile(path); err != nil {
		return claim, err
	}
	file, err := os.Open(path)
	if err != nil {
		return claim, err
	}
	data, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, mappingByteLimit+1))
	if err := errors.Join(readErr, file.Close()); err != nil {
		return claim, err
	}
	err = decodeMappingJSON(data, &claim)
	return claim, err
}

func validateMappingClaim(directory string, expected mappingClaim) error {
	if err := validatePrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	claim, err := readMappingClaim(filepath.Join(directory, "claim.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if !reflect.DeepEqual(claim, expected) {
		return errors.New("mapping owner claim belongs to a different attempt or logon")
	}
	return nil
}

func createMappingClaim(directory string, claim mappingClaim) error {
	if err := createPrivateDirectory(directory); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("mapping owner/root attempt is already consumed or unavailable: %w", err)
	}
	file, err := os.OpenFile(filepath.Join(directory, "claim.json"), os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL, 0600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return errors.Join(writeMappingJSONFile(file, claim), file.Close())
}

type mappingCommandRequest struct {
	Version    int          `json:"version"`
	Action     string       `json:"action"`
	RunID      string       `json:"run_id"`
	SourceSHA  string       `json:"source_sha"`
	Nonce      string       `json:"fixture_nonce"`
	Volume     string       `json:"volume"`
	Sequence   uint64       `json:"sequence"`
	StateFile  string       `json:"state_file"`
	Owner      mappingOwner `json:"owner"`
	LocalPath  string       `json:"local_path"`
	RemotePath string       `json:"remote_path"`
	TCPPort    uint16       `json:"tcp_port"`
}

func (r mappingCommandRequest) options() options {
	return options{RunID: r.RunID, SourceSHA: r.SourceSHA, FixtureNonce: r.Nonce, Volume: r.Volume, Sequence: r.Sequence, StateFile: r.StateFile, Phase: "current-smb-cold"}
}

func validateMappingRequest(r mappingCommandRequest) error {
	if r.Version != 1 || !identifier(r.RunID, 64) || !lowerHex(r.SourceSHA, 40) || !lowerHex(r.Nonce, 64) || r.Volume != fixtureVolume || r.Sequence != 2 || !strings.HasPrefix(r.Owner.SID, "S-1-") || len(r.Owner.SID) > 184 || !lowerHex(r.Owner.AuthenticationID, 16) || r.Owner.WindowsBuild < 26100 {
		return errors.New("native mapping request identity is invalid")
	}
	if !filepath.IsAbs(r.StateFile) || filepath.Base(r.StateFile) != "probe-state.json" || filepath.Base(filepath.Dir(r.StateFile)) != "evidence" {
		return errors.New("native mapping state-file identity is invalid")
	}
	if r.Action == "inventory" {
		if r.LocalPath != "" || r.RemotePath != "" || r.TCPPort != 0 {
			return errors.New("inventory request has a mutation target")
		}
		return nil
	}
	if r.Action != "create" && r.Action != "remove" {
		return errors.New("native mapping action is invalid")
	}
	if len(r.LocalPath) != 2 || r.LocalPath[0] < 'D' || r.LocalPath[0] > 'Z' || r.LocalPath[1] != ':' || r.RemotePath != `\\127.0.0.1\rfs-`+r.Nonce || r.TCPPort == 0 {
		return errors.New("native mapping mutation target is invalid")
	}
	return nil
}

type mappingCommandResult struct {
	Version        int              `json:"version"`
	RequestSHA256  string           `json:"request_sha256"`
	Action         string           `json:"action"`
	Owner          mappingOwner     `json:"owner"`
	OwnerAfter     *mappingOwner    `json:"owner_after,omitempty"`
	Knowledge      string           `json:"knowledge"`
	APIStatus      *uint32          `json:"api_status,omitempty"`
	Snapshot       *mappingSnapshot `json:"snapshot,omitempty"`
	Cause          string           `json:"cause"`
	CauseTruncated bool             `json:"cause_truncated"`
	Requested      mappingAPIFacts  `json:"requested_api"`
}

type mappingAPIFacts struct {
	Name                string `json:"name"`
	Flags               uint32 `json:"flags"`
	AuthBytes           uint32 `json:"auth_bytes"`
	Force               bool   `json:"force"`
	TransportOptionsHex string `json:"transport_options_hex"`
}

func mappingRequestedAPI(request mappingCommandRequest) mappingAPIFacts {
	switch request.Action {
	case "create":
		option, _ := mappingTransportOptions(request.TCPPort)
		return mappingAPIFacts{Name: "WNetAddConnection4W", Flags: mappingRequireIntegrity, TransportOptionsHex: fmt.Sprintf("%x", option)}
	case "remove":
		return mappingAPIFacts{Name: "WNetCancelConnection2W"}
	case "inventory":
		return mappingAPIFacts{Name: "WNetOpenEnumW/WNetEnumResourceW/WNetGetConnectionW/QueryDosDeviceW/GetLogicalDrives"}
	default:
		return mappingAPIFacts{}
	}
}

type mappingHelperServices struct {
	Owner     func() (mappingOwner, error)
	Job       func() error
	Authorize func(mappingCommandRequest) (mappingLedger, error)
	Native    mappingNativeOps
}

func runMappingHelperWith(args []string, input io.Reader, output io.Writer, service mappingHelperServices) error {
	if len(args) != 0 {
		return errors.New("mapping helper accepts no arguments")
	}
	frame, err := bufio.NewReader(io.LimitReader(input, 4097)).ReadBytes('\n')
	if err != nil || len(frame) > 4096 || len(frame) == 0 || frame[len(frame)-1] != '\n' {
		return errors.Join(err, errors.New("mapping helper requires one bounded LF JSON frame"))
	}
	var request mappingCommandRequest
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(frame, &request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	fields, err := mappingRequiredFields(frame, "version", "action", "run_id", "source_sha", "fixture_nonce", "volume", "sequence", "state_file", "owner", "local_path", "remote_path", "tcp_port")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if _, err := mappingRequiredFields(fields["owner"], "sid", "authentication_id", "windows_build"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validateMappingRequest(request); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result := mappingCommandResult{Version: 1, RequestSHA256: fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(frame)), Action: request.Action, Knowledge: "not-invoked", Requested: mappingRequestedAPI(request)}
	owner, operationErr := service.Owner()
	result.Owner = owner
	if operationErr == nil && owner != request.Owner {
		operationErr = errors.New("native helper primary SID or authentication logon changed")
	}
	if operationErr == nil {
		operationErr = service.Job()
	}
	if operationErr == nil {
		var ledger mappingLedger
		ledger, operationErr = service.Authorize(request)
		if operationErr == nil && request.Action != "inventory" {
			var snapshot mappingSnapshot
			snapshot, operationErr = nativeMappingSnapshot(owner, service.Native)
			if operationErr == nil {
				operationErr = validateMappingMutationSnapshot(request, ledger, snapshot)
			}
		}
	}
	if operationErr == nil {
		switch request.Action {
		case "inventory":
			result.Knowledge = "inventory-error"
			var snapshot mappingSnapshot
			snapshot, operationErr = nativeMappingSnapshot(owner, service.Native)
			if operationErr == nil {
				result.Knowledge = "inventory"
				result.Snapshot = &snapshot
			}
		case "create":
			var invoked bool
			var code uint32
			invoked, code, operationErr = mappingNativeCreate(request.LocalPath, request.RemotePath, request.TCPPort, service.Native)
			if invoked {
				result.Knowledge = "returned"
				result.APIStatus = &code
				if code != 0 {
					operationErr = fmt.Errorf("WNetAddConnection4W status %d", code)
				}
			}
		case "remove":
			code := service.Native.Cancel(request.LocalPath, 0, false)
			result.Knowledge = "returned"
			result.APIStatus = &code
			if code != 0 {
				operationErr = fmt.Errorf("WNetCancelConnection2W status %d", code)
			}
		}
		after, ownerErr := service.Owner()
		if ownerErr == nil {
			result.OwnerAfter = &after
		}
		if ownerErr == nil && after != owner {
			result.Owner = after
			ownerErr = errors.New("native helper owner changed during API call")
		}
		operationErr = errors.Join(operationErr, ownerErr)
	}
	if operationErr != nil {
		result.Cause, result.CauseTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(operationErr.Error(), 1024)
	}
	data, encodeErr := json.Marshal(result)
	if encodeErr != nil {
		return errors.Join(operationErr, encodeErr)
	}
	if len(data)+1 > mappingByteLimit {
		return errors.Join(operationErr, errors.New("mapping helper final reply exceeds bound"))
	}
	data = append(data, '\n')
	n, writeErr := output.Write(data)
	if writeErr == nil && n != len(data) {
		writeErr = io.ErrShortWrite
	}
	return errors.Join(operationErr, writeErr)
}

func runMappingHelper(args []string, input io.Reader, output io.Writer) error {
	return runMappingHelperWith(args, input, output, mappingHelperServices{currentMappingOwner, requireMappingJob, authorizeMappingHelper, systemMappingOps()})
}

func validateMappingResult(data []byte, request mappingCommandRequest) (mappingCommandResult, error) {
	var result mappingCommandResult
	if len(data) == 0 || data[len(data)-1] != '\n' || bytes.Count(data, []byte{'\n'}) != 1 {
		return result, errors.New("native mapping reply is not one complete JSON line")
	}
	if err := decodeMappingJSON(data, &result); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	fields, err := mappingRequiredFields(data, "version", "request_sha256", "action", "owner", "knowledge", "cause", "cause_truncated", "requested_api")
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if _, err := mappingRequiredFields(fields["owner"], "sid", "authentication_id", "windows_build"); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	if _, err := mappingRequiredFields(fields["requested_api"], "name", "flags", "auth_bytes", "force", "transport_options_hex"); err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	frame, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return result, err
	}
	frame = append(frame, '\n')
	if result.Version != 1 || result.RequestSHA256 != fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(frame)) || result.Action != request.Action || result.Owner != request.Owner || result.Requested != mappingRequestedAPI(request) {
		return result, errors.New("native mapping reply does not bind the request and owner")
	}
	if len(result.Cause) > 1024 {
		return result, errors.New("native mapping reply cause exceeds bound")
	}
	if result.Knowledge == "not-invoked" {
		if result.APIStatus != nil || result.Snapshot != nil || result.Cause == "" {
			return result, errors.New("not-invoked reply has contradictory facts")
		}
		return result, nil
	}
	if result.OwnerAfter == nil || *result.OwnerAfter != request.Owner {
		return result, errors.New("native mapping helper did not retain the same owner after its call")
	}
	if request.Action == "inventory" {
		if result.Knowledge == "inventory-error" && result.APIStatus == nil && result.Snapshot == nil && result.Cause != "" {
			return result, nil
		}
		if result.Knowledge != "inventory" || result.APIStatus != nil || result.Snapshot == nil || result.Cause != "" || result.CauseTruncated || result.Snapshot.Owner != request.Owner {
			return result, errors.New("native inventory reply is incomplete")
		}
		snapshotFields, err := mappingRequiredFields(fields["snapshot"], "owner", "rows", "connections", "dos_devices", "logical_drives")
		if err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
		var connections map[string]json.RawMessage
		if err := json.Unmarshal(snapshotFields["connections"], &connections); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
		for _, value := range connections {
			if _, err := mappingRequiredFields(value, "status", "remote_path"); err != nil {
				return result, err
			}
		}
		var rows []json.RawMessage
		if err := json.Unmarshal(snapshotFields["rows"], &rows); err != nil {
			return result, err
		}
		for _, value := range rows {
			if _, err := mappingRequiredFields(value, "local_path", "remote_path"); err != nil {
				return result, err
			}
		}
		return result, checkMappingSnapshot(*result.Snapshot)
	}
	if result.Knowledge != "returned" || result.APIStatus == nil || result.Snapshot != nil {
		return result, errors.New("native mutation reply lacks a call-return fact")
	}
	if *result.APIStatus != 0 && result.Cause == "" {
		return result, errors.New("native failure status lacks its cause")
	}
	return result, nil
}

type nativeMappingBackend struct {
	o                options
	owner            mappingOwner
	host             platform
	executable, root string
	runner           mappingRunner
}

func newNativeMappingBackend(o options) (mappingBackend, error) {
	if err := requireMappingJob(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	host, err := newPlatform()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := host.Preflight(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	owner, err := currentMappingOwner()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	root, err := mappingRootFromExecutable(executable, o)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(executable); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(executable)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return nil, errors.New("mapping helper executable is not regular")
	}
	runner, err := mappingRunnerFacts(os.Getenv, o.RunID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &nativeMappingBackend{o, owner, host, executable, root, runner}, nil
}

func (b *nativeMappingBackend) request(action string, ledger mappingLedger) mappingCommandRequest {
	return mappingCommandRequest{1, action, b.o.RunID, b.o.SourceSHA, b.o.FixtureNonce, b.o.Volume, b.o.Sequence, b.o.StateFile, b.owner, ledger.LocalPath, ledger.RemotePath, ledger.TCPPort}
}

func (b *nativeMappingBackend) command(ctx context.Context, action string, ledger mappingLedger) (mappingCommandResult, error) {
	if err := requireMappingJob(); err != nil {
		return mappingCommandResult{}, err
	}
	owner, err := currentMappingOwner()
	if err != nil {
		return mappingCommandResult{}, err
	}
	if owner != b.owner {
		return mappingCommandResult{}, errors.New("mapping SID or authentication logon changed before helper")
	}
	request := b.request(action, ledger)
	commandCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 4*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	execution, commandErr := executeNativeMapping(commandCtx, b.host, b.executable, filepath.Dir(b.o.StateFile), request)
	after, ownerErr := currentMappingOwner()
	if ownerErr == nil && after != owner {
		ownerErr = errors.New("mapping SID or authentication logon changed during helper")
	}
	return finishMappingCommand(commandCtx, request, execution, commandErr, ownerErr)
}

func finishMappingCommand(ctx context.Context, request mappingCommandRequest, execution mappingExecution, commandErr, ownerErr error) (mappingCommandResult, error) {
	result, validationErr := validateMappingResult(execution.Stdout, request)
	resultErr := errors.Join(commandErr, validationErr, ownerErr, ctx.Err())
	if !execution.Diagnostic.StartAttempted && len(execution.Stdout) != 0 {
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, errors.New("native reply appeared without an attempted helper launch"))
	}
	if !execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed {
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, errors.New("native helper quiescence is unconfirmed"))
	}
	outcome := mappingMutation{Knowledge: "unknown", HelperQuiesced: execution.Diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed}
	if !execution.Diagnostic.StartAttempted {
		outcome.Knowledge = "not-invoked"
	} else if validationErr == nil && ownerErr == nil {
		outcome.Knowledge = result.Knowledge
		outcome.Code = result.APIStatus
	}
	if request.Action != "inventory" {
		execution.Diagnostic.Outcome = &outcome
	}
	if validationErr == nil && result.Cause != "" {
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, errors.New(result.Cause))
	}
	if resultErr != nil {
		resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, encodeMappingDiagnostic(execution.Diagnostic))
		if request.Action != "inventory" {
			resultErr = &mappingOutcomeError{resultErr, outcome}
		}
		return result, resultErr
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (b *nativeMappingBackend) Snapshot(ctx context.Context) (mappingSnapshot, error) {
	result, err := b.command(ctx, "inventory", mappingLedger{})
	if err != nil {
		return mappingSnapshot{}, err
	}
	return *result.Snapshot, nil
}
func (b *nativeMappingBackend) Create(ctx context.Context, ledger mappingLedger) error {
	_, err := b.command(ctx, "create", ledger)
	return err
}
func (b *nativeMappingBackend) Remove(ctx context.Context, ledger mappingLedger, row mappingRow) error {
	if row.LocalPath != ledger.LocalPath || row.RemotePath != ledger.RemotePath {
		return errors.New("removal row differs from owned intent")
	}
	_, err := b.command(ctx, "remove", ledger)
	return err
}

func authorizeMappingHelper(request mappingCommandRequest) (mappingLedger, error) {
	var ledger mappingLedger
	o := request.options()
	if err := mappingOptions(o); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	if _, err := readState(o); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	executable, err := os.Executable()
	if err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	root, err := mappingRootFromExecutable(executable, o)
	if err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	if err := rejectPrivateReparsePath(executable); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(executable)
	if err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return ledger, errors.New("mapping helper executable is not regular")
	}
	runner, err := mappingRunnerFacts(os.Getenv, o.RunID)
	if err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	if err := validateMappingClaim(mappingOwnerDirectory(root, request.Owner), mappingExpectedClaim(o, request.Owner, runner)); err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	if request.Action == "inventory" {
		return ledger, nil
	}
	ledger, err = readMappingLedger(mappingLedgerPath(o), o)
	if err != nil {
		return ledger, err
	}
	if ledger.Owner != request.Owner || ledger.LocalPath != request.LocalPath || ledger.RemotePath != request.RemotePath || ledger.TCPPort != request.TCPPort {
		return ledger, errors.New("native mutation differs from its durable ledger")
	}
	if request.Action == "create" && ledger.CreateOutcome.Knowledge != "pending" || request.Action == "remove" && ledger.RemoveOutcome.Knowledge != "pending" {
		return ledger, errors.New("native mutation lacks matching durable pending intent")
	}
	if request.Action == "remove" && !mappingMutationSucceeded(ledger.CreateOutcome) {
		return ledger, errors.New("native removal lacks settled successful creation")
	}
	return ledger, nil
}

func validateMappingMutationSnapshot(request mappingCommandRequest, ledger mappingLedger, snapshot mappingSnapshot) error {
	if err := preserveMappingBaseline(ledger, snapshot); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	row, err := matchingRows(snapshot, request.LocalPath, request.RemotePath)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	targets := snapshot.Devices[request.LocalPath]
	connection := snapshot.Connections[request.LocalPath]
	if request.Action == "create" {
		if row != nil || len(targets) != 0 || connection.Status != mappingNotConnected || snapshot.LogicalDrives&(1<<uint(request.LocalPath[0]-'A')) != 0 {
			return errors.New("native create refuses a pre-existing drive or nonce share")
		}
		return nil
	}
	if row == nil || len(targets) == 0 || connection.Status != 0 || connection.RemotePath != request.RemotePath || !reflect.DeepEqual(targets, ledger.ObservedDevice) {
		return errors.New("native removal refuses a changed row, lookup or DOS binding")
	}
	return nil
}

const mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit = 2 << 10

type mappingBoundedBuffer struct {
	buffer   bytes.Buffer
	observed int64
	prefix   []byte
}

func (b *mappingBoundedBuffer) Bytes() []byte { return b.buffer.Bytes() }
func (b *mappingBoundedBuffer) Len() int      { return b.buffer.Len() }

func (b *mappingBoundedBuffer) Write(data []byte) (int, error) {
	b.observed += int64(len(data))
	if len(b.prefix) < mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit {
		b.prefix = append(b.prefix, data[:min(len(data), mappingDiagnosticStreamLimit-len(b.prefix))]...)
	}
	if len(data) > mappingByteLimit-b.Len() {
		return 0, errors.New("mapping command output exceeds 1 MiB")
	}
	return b.buffer.Write(data)
}

type mappingStreamDiagnostic struct {
	ObservedBytes   int64  `json:"observed_bytes"`
	PrefixBase64    string `json:"prefix_base64"`
	PrefixTruncated bool   `json:"prefix_truncated"`
}

func (b *mappingBoundedBuffer) diagnostic() mappingStreamDiagnostic {
	return mappingStreamDiagnostic{b.observed, base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(b.prefix), b.observed > int64(len(b.prefix))}
}

type mappingCommandDiagnostic struct {
	StartAttempted            bool                    `json:"start_attempted"`
	Requested                 mappingAPIFacts         `json:"requested_api"`
	Outcome                   *mappingMutation        `json:"validated_outcome,omitempty"`
	Action                    string                  `json:"action"`
	ActionTruncated           bool                    `json:"action_truncated"`
	PID                       *uint32                 `json:"pid,omitempty"`
	ElapsedMillis             int64                   `json:"elapsed_ms"`
	PreCleanupDone            *bool                   `json:"pre_cleanup_done,omitempty"`
	PreCleanupResult          *string                 `json:"pre_cleanup_result_error,omitempty"`
	PreCleanupResultTruncated bool                    `json:"pre_cleanup_result_error_truncated"`
	WriteStarted              bool                    `json:"write_started"`
	WriteReturned             bool                    `json:"write_returned"`
	WriteComplete             bool                    `json:"write_complete"`
	InputBytes                int                     `json:"input_bytes"`
	InputSHA256               string                  `json:"input_sha256"`
	InputLineBytes            int                     `json:"input_line_bytes"`
	InputLineSHA256           string                  `json:"input_line_sha256"`
	WriteBytes                int                     `json:"write_bytes"`
	WriteError                string                  `json:"write_error"`
	WriteErrorTruncated       bool                    `json:"write_error_truncated"`
	WorkersStarted            int                     `json:"workers_started"`
	WorkersJoined             int                     `json:"workers_joined"`
	CleanupAttempted          bool                    `json:"cleanup_attempted"`
	CleanupConfirmed          bool                    `json:"cleanup_confirmed"`
	CleanupForced             bool                    `json:"cleanup_forced"`
	CleanupError              string                  `json:"cleanup_error"`
	CleanupErrorTruncated     bool                    `json:"cleanup_error_truncated"`
	Launch                    *windowsLaunchFacts     `json:"launch,omitempty"`
	Stdout                    mappingStreamDiagnostic `json:"stdout_observed"`
	Stderr                    mappingStreamDiagnostic `json:"stderr_observed"`
}

type mappingExecution struct {
	Stdout     []byte
	Diagnostic mappingCommandDiagnostic
}

type mappingDiagnosticError struct {
	details mappingCommandDiagnostic
	encoded string
}

func (e *mappingDiagnosticError) Error() string { return "mapping command diagnostic: " + e.encoded }

func mappingDiagnosticText(value string, limit int) (string, bool) {
	if len(value) > limit {
		return value[:limit], true
	}
	return value, false
}

func encodeMappingDiagnostic(details mappingCommandDiagnostic) error {
	data, err := json.Marshal(details)
	if err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("encode mapping command diagnostic: %w", err)
	}
	if len(data) >= 16<<10 {
		return errors.New("mapping command diagnostic exceeded 16 KiB")
	}
	return &mappingDiagnosticError{details: details, encoded: string(data)}
}

// The caller runs inside the watchdog-owned probe or tagged diagnostic test.
func executeNativeMapping(ctx context.Context, host platform, executable, directory string, request mappingCommandRequest) (execution mappingExecution, resultErr error) {
	started := time.Now()
	var process child
	var stdout, stderr mappingBoundedBuffer
	var streams chan error
	drained := 0
	diagnostic := &execution.Diagnostic
	diagnostic.Requested = mappingRequestedAPI(request)
	diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = true
	diagnostic.Action, diagnostic.ActionTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(request.Action, 64)
	var writeStarted, writeReturned, resultObserved bool
	var writeBytes int
	var writeErr, processErr error
	defer func() {
		var launchError *windowsLaunchError
		if errors.As(resultErr, &launchError) {
			facts := launchError.Facts
			diagnostic.Launch = &facts
			diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = facts.CleanupConfirmed
		}
		if process != nil {
			if observer, ok := process.(interface{ LaunchFacts() windowsLaunchFacts }); ok {
				facts := observer.LaunchFacts()
				diagnostic.Launch = &facts
			}
			pid := process.PID()
			diagnostic.PID = &pid
			done := false
			select {
			case <-process.Done():
				done = true
			default:
			}
			diagnostic.PreCleanupDone = &done
			if done {
				if !resultObserved {
					processErr, resultObserved = process.Result(), true
				}
				resultText := ""
				if processErr != nil {
					resultText, diagnostic.PreCleanupResultTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(processErr.Error(), 512)
				}
				diagnostic.PreCleanupResult = &resultText
			}
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, processErr)
			diagnostic.CleanupAttempted = true
			forced, finishErr := process.Finish()
			diagnostic.CleanupForced = forced
			diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = finishErr == nil
			if finishErr != nil {
				diagnostic.CleanupError, diagnostic.CleanupErrorTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(finishErr.Error(), 512)
			}
			resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, finishErr)
			if forced {
				resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, errors.New("mapping command required forced owned-job termination"))
			}
			if streams != nil {
				// Finish closes the owned pipes; no capture is read until every worker has joined.
				for drained < 3 {
					resultErr = errors.Join(resultErr, <-streams)
					drained++
				}
			}
		}
		diagnostic.WorkersJoined = drained
		diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed && drained == diagnostic.WorkersStarted
		diagnostic.ElapsedMillis = time.Since(started).Milliseconds()
		diagnostic.WriteStarted, diagnostic.WriteReturned, diagnostic.WriteBytes = writeStarted, writeReturned, writeBytes
		diagnostic.WriteComplete = writeReturned && writeErr == nil && writeBytes == diagnostic.InputBytes
		if writeErr != nil {
			diagnostic.WriteError, diagnostic.WriteErrorTruncated = mappingDiagnosticText(writeErr.Error(), 512)
		}

		diagnostic.Stdout, diagnostic.Stderr = stdout.diagnostic(), stderr.diagnostic()
		execution.Stdout = append([]byte(nil), stdout.Bytes()...)
	}()
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return execution, err
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return execution, err
	}
	if len(data)+1 > 4096 {
		return execution, errors.New("mapping command input exceeds 4 KiB")
	}
	diagnostic.InputLineBytes, diagnostic.InputLineSHA256 = len(data), fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data))
	data = append(data, '\n')
	diagnostic.InputBytes = len(data)
	diagnostic.InputSHA256 = fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data))
	diagnostic.CleanupConfirmed = false
	diagnostic.StartAttempted = true
	process, err = host.StartWithEnvironment(executable, []string{"--mapping-helper"}, directory, os.Environ())
	if err != nil {
		return execution, err
	}
	streams = make(chan error, 3)
	diagnostic.WorkersStarted = 3
	go func() { _, err := io.Copy(&stdout, process.Output()); streams <- err }()
	go func() { _, err := io.Copy(&stderr, process.Errors()); streams <- err }()
	go func() {
		writeStarted = true
		writeBytes, writeErr = process.Input().Write(data)
		if writeErr == nil && writeBytes != len(data) {
			writeErr = io.ErrShortWrite
		}
		writeReturned = true

		streams <- writeErr
	}()
	done := process.Done()
	finished := false
	for !finished || drained != 3 {
		select {
		case err := <-streams:
			drained++
			if err != nil {
				return execution, err
			}
		case <-done:
			finished = true
			done = nil
			processErr, resultObserved = process.Result(), true
		case <-ctx.Done():
			return execution, ctx.Err()
		}
	}
	return execution, nil
}
